title: Engine pin of the ServiceNow MCP contract
description: What the engine's governance texts and skills depend on, and the hash of the server contract they were written against. A rename or a re-gate on the server side cannot merge without a conscious change here (P-36).

contractVersion.description: The contract shape this file is written against, not the server version.

contractSha256.description: sha256 of packages/snowarch/dist/contract.json, byte for byte. Written by pin.mjs, never by hand.

serverKey.description: The MCP registration key. Duplicated from engine.config.json on purpose: a second, independently edited declaration that the lint cross-checks (L07). engine.config.json remains the value of record.

gate.description: The flag family that refuses FIRST. For a tool behind two gates this is the outer one, and alsoRequires carries the second.

alsoRequires.description: A second gate the tool enforces after the first has passed. Six tools have one (now_assist then write, fluent then write). Optional, and additive: a consumer that ignores it still predicts the first refusal correctly — but the ask-list generator must union it, or those six are under-reported.

mutates.description: True when a successful call changes state on the ServiceNow INSTANCE. Server-local state does not count.

sessionMutates.description: True when a call changes which instance later calls address, without changing anything on any instance. snow_core_instance_switch only, and its mutates stays false. The ask-list is generated from the union of the two.

used_by.description: Who depends on this tool. Vocabulary: a governance section, a command, VALIDATION-TESTS, or the directory name of a .claude/skills/<name> or .claude/agents/<name>. Validated by the lint (L-series).
